thread:
maria (Finance): Heads-up — Orion Robotics invoice INV-4332 failed on card capture. Gateway returned error 'acquirer_account_mismatch'. Customer says they updated card yesterday, but autopay retried and still failed. Any quick ideas?

ajay (Billing): Can you paste the raw gateway response and txn id? want to see acquirer code.

maria (Finance): Here you go:
```
{
  "error": "acquirer_account_mismatch",
  "code": 4102,
  "txn_id": "tx_9ab3f2e7",
  "acquirer": "globalpay-eu",
  "bin": "557788"
}
```

nick (Payments Ops): Looks like routing vs merchant-config mismatch. GlobalPay sometimes routes cards from certain BIN ranges to a EU acquirer that isn't configured for our merchant account. :thinking_face:

sara (Support): Customer is on autopay and we've retried 3x (48h window). We sent a payment link Friday but no update. Suggest we either send an urgent manual link + auth or offer wire as fallback since they need access Monday.

maria (Finance): We need this cleared before Monday or they'll push prod start. Can CS confirm if wire is acceptable? Also we need a PDF of wire instructions to send securely.

stella (CS): I just messaged their finance contact — they replied that wire is fine. They asked for our bank details and an invoice copy showing the tax breakdown. I don't see a wire profile on their account in Stripe metadata.

ajay (Billing): We don't store wire instructions for customers by default. Finance can generate a secure upload link and we can process once funds are received. Alternative quick fix: generate a single-use card-update link and allow a one-click retry.

maria (Finance): I'll assemble the wire instructions + invoice copy. Can someone confirm GL mapping — use `services:infra` for this invoice? Also set the invoice hold behavior: once wire clears, mark invoice paid and release any provisioning holds.

nick (Payments Ops): Created internal action PAY-8924 to track manual retry flow and routing investigation. If they opt for wire, we'll wait for settlement, then clear. If they update card, I'll attempt a one-time capture and log BIN/acquirer for routing policy updates. :white_check_mark:

stella (CS): Orion confirmed: "We'll send wire by EOD with beneficiary and routing." I asked them to upload to the secure link only (no email attachments). I cc'd compliance for the secure transfer.

maria (Finance): Preparing the wire-instructions.pdf now. Will upload to secure storage and paste one-time link here for CS to forward. Also note: set retry_window = 72h in the invoice notes so ops won't auto-cancel while waiting.

ajay (Billing): Quick doc note for follow-up: save the acquirer error code (4102) + BIN (557788) on the invoice record — we'll use that to adjust our routing map and avoid future false rejections. cc @nick

maria (Finance): Thanks — I'll attach the gateway error and the internal ticket to the invoice for the audit trail. Once the funds confirm, I'll update the invoice status.

stella (CS): I'll stay on point with the customer and confirm when they've initiated the wire. If anything changes, I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
